_comment: Syncline config — one per repo you want to mirror to a GitHub Project. Copy this to e.g. configs/subby.config.json and fill in. All *_file paths are resolved RELATIVE TO THIS CONFIG FILE's directory (or pass absolute paths). State/cache files are written next to wherever you point them — keep them out of version control if your plan dir is gitignored.
_status_map: Maps each RAW plan status (left) to the exact board Status option NAME (right). The board must already have these options (case-insensitive match). Add rows for every status your plan uses.
_done_statuses: Which RAW statuses mean the issue should be CLOSED (and which make an epic roll up to done). Usually just done.
_type_field_name: Custom single-select field tagging each item Epic/Story. NOTE: 'Type' is a RESERVED Projects v2 field name and cannot be created — use 'Work Type' (the default). The importer creates it if absent.
_files: Where the plan + Syncline's own bookkeeping live. For a BMAD layout these sit under _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts (gitignored). plan_file is the sprint status the sync reads; epics_file + story_spec_glob feed the manifest builder; manifest_file/state_file/cache_file are Syncline's artifacts.
label: subby
_regexes: Plan line patterns. Defaults match a BMAD sprint-status.yaml: two-space-indented 'epic-N: status' and 'N-M-slug: status'. Override only if your plan format differs. For the SYNC: epic_line_regex/story_line_regex capture group(1)=key, group(2)=status. For the MANIFEST builder the groups differ (it needs the numbers) — see syncline_build_manifest defaults; override there via the same keys if needed.
